verdict.reasons: The image successfully displays the required AFP drip irrigation tape roll with authentic, readable branding and the correct white-and-blue cylindrical packaging. The commercial product is integrated realistically into an agricultural soil bed. The installation evidence includes a standard pressure gauge and a lateral line; while the physical construction of the gauge connecting directly to a surface loop of tape is a slight technical simplification, it is visually plausible and not a gross geometric defect. The required phone number watermark is present and properly formatted. There are no people, collages, or conflicting crop elements. Minor advisory issues include the packaging sitting flush with the soil (no gap) and the stylized layout of the gauge, but these do not affect the overall quality or utility of the illustration.

focused_physical_review.reason: The black irrigation tubing is coiled and positioned on the soil to the right of the package, leaving a visible soil gap between the two objects, but the area directly behind the package is obscured by the field depth and plants, preventing verification of a complete gap around the footprint. No lines are seen touching, emerging from, or crossing the white and blue package base. The single black ring on the ground is part of the installed lateral with the gauge and is not an extra loose coil. No ribbons, straps, or tape tails are protruding from the sides or base of the product packaging.

acceptance_warnings: Independent physical condition not met: clear_soil_gap
